formula_source: Bailey & Lopez de Prado, "The Deflated Sharpe Ratio", Journal of Investment Management, 2014. PSR adjusted for multiple trials via the cross-trial variance of trial Sharpes: DSR = Phi((SR_best - SR_bench) / s_trials), SR_bench = 0.
